encode_video_with_autoencoder_kl_wan: encode a batch of video frames into latent representations using AutoencoderKLWan
decode_latents_with_autoencoder_kl_wan: decode latent vectors back into video frames using AutoencoderKLWan
enable_tiling_autoencoder_kl_wan: enable tiled VAE decoding on AutoencoderKLWan to process large videos with less memory
run_forward_pass_autoencoder_kl_wan: run a full encode-decode forward pass on AutoencoderKLWan with optional posterior sampling
use_wan_causal_conv3d: use WanCausalConv3d for causal 3D convolution with feature caching support for video processing
